selection_rationale: v6.1 R4 P3 — net_IR + Diebold-Mariano stat sig (Memmel 2003 SR diff closed form) double criterion. ΔSR DM t > 2 + Δ MDD <= 2pp + Turnover_yr <= 30% 강제. Hook strict.

candidates_excluded_reasons.name: 11_cvar_lp_min
candidates_excluded_reasons.reason: Rglpk package unavailable on system. fallback static. No CVaR LP eval performed.

candidates_excluded_reasons.name: 15_kelly_clipped
candidates_excluded_reasons.reason: init period (60m lookback) leaves first 35 months valid + 100 months NA weights — perf_metrics filters NA → SR 2.73 spurious. Re-eval with forward-fill (15_kelly_halfk v2) → still inconsistent due to Kelly corner solutions. REJECT.

method_log.name: 01_static_baseline
method_log.selection_basis: DM test 통과 dynamic candidate 부재. R12 No Silent Override 정합.

method_log.name: 02_static_ew4
method_log.rejection_reason: (1) STAT NS: DM p-value 0.18 > 0.05. (2) ALPHA REDEFINITION: EW4 implies 1715 H1 weight 50% → 25% downweight + cash 5% → 25% upweight. 이는 S4 v2 admit alpha thesis 침범 + Hook 'alpha 재정의 금지' violation. Optimizer 영역 외부.

method_log.name: 03_mvo_rolling
method_log.description: Markowitz rolling MVO (lookback 60m, λ=2.0, sleeve bounds [0.70/0.40/0.40/0.30])
method_log.rejection_reason: MVO rolling는 sample variance + return 의존 → overfitting tendency. 256m run에서 SR 1.84 (vs baseline 1.86) NS dominated. Turnover 19.9% (135m). REJECT.

method_log.name: 04_hrp_static_3sleeve
method_log.description: Hierarchical Risk Parity (López de Prado 2016), 3-sleeve only + cash 5% fixed
method_log.rejection_reason: HRP static는 cor 거리 기반 cluster. 3-sleeve 단순 (orthogonal 4-sleeve composite) → HRP allocation은 inverse-vol bias 강함 → str1715 weight 너무 낮음 (실측 0.142). risk_contributions와 alpha source 미부합. NS DM test.

method_log.name: 05_hrp_rolling_3sleeve
method_log.rejection_reason: HRP rolling은 covariance instability에 민감. 3-sleeve simple structure에서 HRP advantage 약함. NS DM test.

method_log.name: 06_erc_rolling
method_log.rejection_reason: ERC rolling은 vol-inverse 기반. CAGR 0.1028 (baseline 0.1738) — risk parity가 high-alpha sleeve(str1715) underweight 유도 + CAGR 1700bps 잃음. NS DM SR test.

method_log.name: 07_regime_4state_crisis_mild
method_log.description: 4-state MRS regime + CRISIS shift str1715 -10pp / kr10y +5pp / tsmom +5pp (Risk Agent finding ⭐ direct interpretation)
method_log.rejection_reason: ΔSR +0.032 NS (p=0.37). MDD -14.91% vs baseline -15.23% 미미 개선. Crisis sub-period: GFC 2008 +8.73% (vs baseline +6.95%) — mild improvement but DM test failure → static retain 정합.

method_log.name: 08_regime_2state_simple
method_log.description: 2-state simple: CRISIS vs not-CRISIS (Risk Agent recommendation, same shift as 07)
method_log.rejection_reason: Equivalent to 07 (CRISIS shift only). NS DM test.

method_log.name: 09_regime_2state_aggr
method_log.description: 2-state aggressive: CRISIS shift str1715 -20pp / kr10y +10pp / tsmom +5pp / cash +5pp
method_log.rejection_reason: ΔSR +0.049 (256m) NS (p=0.51). 그러나 MDD -14.51% vs -15.23% (-0.72pp 개선) + CVaR_95 5.07% vs 5.51% (-0.44pp) + GFC 2008 +10.50% vs +6.95% (Crisis sub-period 명확 우월). DM test 통과 못하지만 risk-management 측면에서 strong 2nd candidate. Future research path 명시 (sample 확장 시 sig 가능).

method_log.name: 10_vol_target_inverse
method_log.rejection_reason: Inverse-vol는 kr10y heavy (low vol) → CAGR 0.0748 매우 낮음. Turnover 35.2% (135m) 위험. Strict 30% cap 위반.

method_log.name: 11_cvar_lp_min
method_log.rejection_reason: Rglpk package unavailable on system. fallback static. No CVaR LP eval. NEEDS package install for future cycle.

method_log.name: 12_max_sharpe_rolling
method_log.rejection_reason: Grid search는 in-sample max Sharpe. 60m lookback OOS → SR boost 미미 (1.66 vs 1.63). overfitting risk + selection objective는 net_IR strict improve. NS DM.

method_log.name: 13_dro_wasserstein
method_log.rejection_reason: DRO eps=0.10 regularization은 covariance flatten → mean-reverting allocation. Static baseline이 SR statistically dominant (DM p=0.0428, static UPward). REJECT.

method_log.name: 14_blackliter_regime
method_log.description: Black-Litterman dynamic with regime view (CRISIS share > 30% → str1715 underperform view)
method_log.rejection_reason: BL view (str1715 underperform 2%/m) is over-aggressive in CRISIS share threshold. SR collapse 1.08 vs baseline 1.63 (joint 135m). NS but DOWN. REJECT.

method_log.name: 16_hybrid_regime_erc
method_log.description: ERC default + CRISIS regime shift (Risk Agent finding × diversification)
method_log.rejection_reason: ERC underweights str1715 → CAGR drag + CRISIS shift도 limited impact. NS DM.

method_log.name: 17_regime_4state_full_quartet
method_log.description: 4-state full quartet shifts (BULL +str1715, CAUTION +kr10y, CRISIS standard)
method_log.rejection_reason: BULL shift (str1715 +5pp) 추가가 도움이 안 됨. NS + slightly down. REJECT.

method_log.name: 18_regime_crisis_tsmom_down
method_log.description: CRISIS shift: tsmom DOWN (Risk Agent str1715-tsmom +0.234 coupling spike → tsmom NOT diversifier in CRISIS)
method_log.rejection_reason: tsmom DOWN interpretation은 Risk Agent finding의 두 해석 중 하나. 결과 similar to 07. NS DM.

rationalization_red_flags_grep.self_rationalization_check: static retain 결정은 'dynamic 우월 입증 실패' 정량 결과에 근거. 회피 표현 grep 통과:
phrases_avoided: 영향 미미 — 아님. CVaR_95 -0.44pp / GFC +3.55pp 정량 측정.
관행적 허용 — 아님. R12 No Silent Override 강제.
보수적이면 괜찮다 — 아님. 안전성 NOT 정당화. 통계적 유의성 실패가 사유.
대부분 결과 동일 — 아님. DM test 256m N=256 power 충분, NS는 진성 NS.

future_research_paths: extended sample (256m + future months as collected) — DM test power 증가 가능, 09_regime_crisis_aggr stat sig 도달 여부 재평가
alternative regime classifiers: HMM_VolDecile_3_State (Hamilton 1989), Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection (Adams-MacKay 2007) — non-percentile based regime — 이는 risk-research 영역
Rglpk install → 11_cvar_lp_min 정식 평가 — tail-aware LP는 본 study에서 미실행
PPO RL dynamic allocation (Jiang-Xu-Liang 2017) — sample 확장 + ML 기반 + 별도 환경
Genetic algorithm multi-objective Pareto frontier — SR/MDD/Turnover 3-axis 동시 최적화
